title: Stabilizing Temporal Difference Learning via Implicit Stochastic Recursion
abstract: arXiv:2505.01361v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal difference (TD) learning is a foundational algorithm in reinforcement learning (RL). For nearly forty years, TD learning has served as a workhorse for applied RL as well as a building block for more complex and specialized algorithms. However, despite its widespread use, TD procedures are generally sensitive to step size specification. A poor choice of step size can dramatically increase variance and slow convergence in both on-policy and off-policy evaluation tasks. In practice, researchers often use trial and error to identify stable step sizes, but these approaches tend to be ad hoc and inefficient. As an alternative, we propose implicit TD algorithms that reformulate TD updates into fixed-point equations. Such updates are more stable and less sensitive to step size without sacrificing computational efficiency. translated_title: 通过隐式随机递归稳定时序差分学习
translated_abstract: 时序差分（TD）学习是强化学习（RL）中的基础算法。近四十年来，TD学习一直是应用RL的主力工具，也是更复杂和专门算法的构建模块。然而，尽管其应用广泛，TD程序通常对步长设置敏感。步长选择不当会显著增加方差，并在在策略和离策略评估任务中减慢收敛速度。在实践中，研究人员常通过试错法来确定稳定的步长，但这些方法往往临时且低效。作为替代，我们提出了隐式TD算法，将TD更新重新表述为不动点方程。这种更新更稳定，对步长敏感性更低，且不牺牲计算效率。此外，我们推导了几乎必然收敛保证和有限时间误差界（含投影步骤）。
tldr: 本文提出隐式TD算法，通过将更新重构为不动点方程，显著提升步长鲁棒性和稳定性，同时保持计算效率，并提供收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes implicit TD algorithms that reformulate updates as fixed-point equations, enhancing step-size robustness and stability while maintaining computational efficiency, with convergence guarantees.
